mainEntity.name: When does it make sense to renovate the whole house instead of moving?

acceptedAnswer.text: A whole-home renovation is often a good choice when you like your neighborhood, lot, and basic house bones but need better layout, more space, updated systems, and a refreshed look to match how you live now.
